answer: Photonic delay attestation deters Sybil agents by measuring light transit times. Verifiers pulse a saffron laser into an agent's chip, timing the faint whisper of interference along an on-chip spiral waveguide. An adversary multiplexing personas across one transceiver induces optical collisions, incurring dedicated silicon photonic dies and lasers per identity. However, ambient thermal drift distorts refractive indices, falsely penalizing legitimate agents.
